description: Test file for import command functions in Mattermost's mmctl CLI, including listing, showing, validating, and deleting import files and jobs.

methods.name: TestImportListAvailableCmdF
methods.description: Unit test for listing available import files, checking both no imports and some imports scenarios.

methods.name: TestImportListIncompleteCmdF
methods.description: Unit test for listing incomplete import uploads, checking both no incomplete uploads and some uploads scenarios.

methods.name: TestImportJobShowCmdF
methods.description: Unit test for showing details of a specific import job, including not found and found cases.

methods.name: TestImportJobListCmdF
methods.description: Unit test for listing import jobs, including no jobs and some jobs scenarios.

methods.name: TestImportProcessCmdF
methods.description: Unit test for creating import process jobs with default, exceeding max workers, and custom workers.

methods.name: TestImportValidateCmdF
methods.description: Unit test for validating import files, including empty files, size limits, invalid paths, and configuration limits.

methods.name: TestDeleteImportCmdF
methods.description: Unit test for deleting import files, including idempotency.
